Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate a high-resolution landscape scientific architecture figure suitable for a CVPR research presentation. White background, immaculate vector-like styling, navy typography, pale blue encoder blocks, teal existing heads, amber proposed training changes. Clear orthogonal arrows, generous whitespace, large readable labels, no overlapping connectors. Title: "CES-FL: proposed upgrade". Subtitle: "Partial fine-tuning + group-robust classification + controlled age invariance". Prominent status badge: "PROPOSED — PERFORMANCE NOT YET VALIDATED". No claimed scores, novelty or SOTA.

Top 55% is the inference architecture, left to right:
A "Input image" (small stylized face thumbnail explicitly illustrative) → B "Detection-pretrained encoder" box split visually into "Early layers: frozen" and amber "Final stage: trainable"; subtitle "Xception / ResNet-50 • BatchNorm frozen".
B outputs "Spatial features F" and splits into two parallel branches:
C1 "Global branch": "g = mean(F)", "Global MLP → z_g", "Sigmoid gate → r_g".
C2 "Local branch": "Shared 1×1 patch MLP → z_p", "Sigmoid patch gate → r_p".
Both branches join D "Positive gated fusion" with exact formulas "M = a_p r_p ⊙ z_p" and "z = a_g r_g z_g + mean(M) + b", and note "a_g, a_p > 0".
D → E "Outputs": "Real / fake score" and separately a small red-blue illustrative grid labeled "Signed LOCAL contribution M". Note "Gates are learned weights; M is not a forgery mask". No demographic metadata fed into inference.

Bottom 35% titled "TRAIN-only upgrades — evaluate as separate ablations". Show three aligned modules:
1 "Group-robust classification": input "Original TRAIN images + labels + group metadata"; "Group DRO on class × demographic groups"; "Regularization + validation selection". Metadata arrow points only to this training module, never encoder.
2 "Controlled age pairs": "Original → independent older / younger edits"; "No-change + resize controls"; "Review identity and forensic preservation"; "Balanced pair anchors each step". Use a small three-image same-person age cartoon strip as illustrative only, not dataset evidence.
3 "Shared-weight consistency": "Original and approved edit → same detector"; "L_inv = mean |asinh(z) − asinh(z_edit)|"; "BCE / group-DRO classification remains on originals". Show original/editor outputs entering the same-weight detector module, then arrows from classification and consistency modules to a box "Train selected encoder stage + heads + gates + fusion". No arrow from edit generation to validation or test.
Bottom narrow footer: "Ablations: BCE → partial fine-tuning → group DRO → age consistency; matched no-change control." Second footer: "Freeze selection and calibration on validation. Compare matched test protocols across seeds."
Use restrained flat scientific design, no decorative circuitry or gradients, no false reliability or causal guarantees. Ensure every arrow corresponds to described flow. The figure is an architecture proposal, not a statement that training has completed.
corrections: Edit this scientific diagram, retaining its overall layout, colors and all correct labels. Fix these precise scientific connection errors. (1) Global branch: g feeds TWO PARALLEL modules, Global MLP producing z_g and Sigmoid gate producing r_g. There MUST NOT be an arrow z_g into the gate. Both outputs go separately toward fusion. (2) Local branch: features F feed TWO PARALLEL modules, Shared 1x1 patch MLP producing z_p and Sigmoid patch gate producing r_p. No arrow z_p into gate. (3) Controlled age pairs: show original at left, older at upper right, younger at lower right, with TWO independent arrows from original. Remove older-to-younger arrow completely. Each age variant is generated directly from original. (4) Shared-weight consistency: BOTH z(x) and z(x_edit) enter the age-invariance consistency loss. ONLY z(x) enters classification loss; edited score does NOT enter classification. Clearly draw these routes. Preserve PROPOSED / PERFORMANCE NOT YET VALIDATED badge. Remove the isolated malformed subscript near Global MLP. Re-render precise, clear diagram with readable text and no arrow crossings.

Make only these final precision corrections to this diagram; retain the remaining layout and all text. In C1 Global branch the r_g output is currently dangling. Connect BOTH z_g AND r_g outputs to D Positive gated fusion using a clearly bracketed joint output labeled '(z_g, r_g)' and a single arrow entering fusion. Likewise ensure both z_p and r_p from C2 visibly enter fusion, using a bracketed joint output '(z_p, r_p)' if necessary; do not accidentally merge global/local branches before fusion. In Controlled age pairs change the younger thumbnail to a clearly adult approximately 25-year-old version of the same man, not a child, preserving the TWO independent arrows from original. In shared-weight consistency ensure the two score routes into consistency terminate with visible arrowheads, and only original z(x) routes into BCE/group-DRO classification. Preserve status PROPOSED PERFORMANCE NOT YET VALIDATED. All typography crisp and all existing correct formulas unchanged.

Keep the entire figure unchanged EXCEPT the bottom-right panel titled '3. Shared-weight consistency'. Redesign just that panel to eliminate misleading individual score arrows. Retain the original and approved edit thumbnails entering the same-weight detector. From that detector draw ONE arrow into ONE combined objective box. The combined objective box must say, with exact readable text: 'Original and edited scores', then 'Classification: ORIGINALS ONLY', then 'Consistency: BOTH scores', then 'L_inv = mean |asinh(z) - asinh(z_edit)|'. Delete the two old separate loss boxes and all old score arrows/labels in this panel. A single arrow from this combined objective box down to the existing train-selected-encoder-stage bar. Do not draw any arrow suggesting edited-image classification. All other panels, equations, bracketed joint head/gate outputs, colors and PROPOSED status remain identical.
